sn45.146-148:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave yā kāci tārakarūpānam pabhā || sabbā tā candimāpabhāya kalaṃ nāgghanti soḷasiṃ || candappabhā tāsam aggam akkhāyati ||
sn45.146-148:2.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave saradasamaye viddhe vigatavalāhake deve ādicco nabham abbhussukkamāno sabbam ākāsagatam tamagatam abhivihacca bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca ||
sn45.146-148:3.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave yāni kānici tantāvutānaṃ vatthānaṃ || kāsikaṃ vatthaṃ tesam aggam akkhāyati ||
sn45.146-148:3.2: evam eva kho bhikkhave ye keci kusalā dhammā sabbe te appamādamūlakā appamādasamosaraṇā ||
sn45.146-148:3.4: Appamattassetam bhikkhave bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkham ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāvessati a- a- maggam bahulīkarissatī
sn45.146-148:3.5: ti || || Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu appamatto ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāveti a- a- maggam bahulīkaroti || || 4.
sn45.146-148:3.6: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāga- nirodha- nissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || la || sammāsamādhim bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitam nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || || 5.
sn45.146-148:3.7: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu appamatto ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāveti ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bahulīkarotī ti || || Sabbam eva sāvatthinidānaṃ || ||
sn45.146-148:4.4: Vatthena dasamam padaṃ || || Yad api Tathāgataṃ tad api vitthāretabbaṃ || || 1.
